description: Server-side schedule notification derivation for ak.profile.calendar_notification_dispatch.v1: one notification per patch per receiver, the pre/post roster union candidate set filtered before generation, the blind-wakeup path for encrypted schedules, and the rule that RSVP writes derive no schedule notification. It deliberately excludes the client authoring, recurrence and RSVP vectors so that requiring this fixture does not pull the client vector closure into a server profile.

semantic_cases.name: notification_single_notification_per_patch
semantic_cases.precondition: one ak.strand.update changes start, end and location together
semantic_cases.expected_projection: exactly one notification_kind=schedule per receiver, deduplicated on (actor_id, source_event_id, notification_kind)

semantic_cases.name: notification_receiver_set_is_pre_and_post_roster
semantic_cases.precondition: a patch removes one attendee and adds another
semantic_cases.expected_projection: candidates are pre_state.attendees union post_state.attendees union assigned_to union watch_all, then filtered by post-state access, mute, DND and push rules before generation

semantic_cases.name: notification_encrypted_schedule_uses_blind_wakeup
semantic_cases.precondition: schedule metadata is encrypted and the server cannot read attendees
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the server emits only the profile-defined blind wakeup over visible assigned and watch relations, never a verified schedule notification, and never widens decryption

semantic_cases.name: notification_rsvp_change_does_not_emit_schedule_notification
semantic_cases.expected_projection: no notification_kind=schedule is produced; RSVP state surfaces through the RSVP projection
